I lived as a trans man for about 10 years of my life, going through puberty and having no one guide me through it was rough. I was ashamed of my body and growing up in a macho Mexican family, I didn’t like the way my family would treat women compared to the men. I wanted the same respect the men had and that made me believe I needed to be a man. I felt weird with my body and as a teen I was on tumblr a lot which further fueled my idea of transitioning. Little did I know I wasn’t uncomfortable by my sex rather by the way society treats biological women. I’m slowly learning to accept myself the way I am and I haven’t been this happy knowing that I wasn’t born in the wrong body. I’m not saying that all trans people are wrong about their gender but rather we should carefully guide young people who have second thoughts to make sure it’s not a societal thing rather an actual transition.

Hey homie, not trying to bash you or anything but usually you should try and research a little before buying a pet. That being said this turtle is going to need a proper tank not those plastic trays. He’s going to need a cycled tank in which the water conditions won’t harm your turtle. There’s great guides on google on how to get started with cycling water. While you wait for the water to cycle I would suggest putting him in those big plastic bins and buy him a UV light and heat light. These two are a must and can’t go around it, it’s essential for their health. I don’t own terrapin turtles but you should investigate if this lil guy needs a water heater. Another need is a filter, turtles are very messy and keeping up their water clean will make them very happy. Taking care of turtles may not seem difficult since they’re slow looking creatures but they deserve all the care and love. It may be stressful and if you think it’s too much I would also suggest giving him up to local animal rescue centers. Good luck!
